title: UI Gallery
desc_button: Six styles, an optional icon and a disabled state. Returns true on the frame it is clicked.
desc_iconbutton: A square icon button; tint and an active (selected) look.
desc_toggle: An on/off switch. You pass the value in and get the new value back.
desc_checkbox: A checkbox with its label; returns the new value.
desc_radio: Returns true when clicked; you decide which one is selected.
desc_slider: A number between min and max, optionally in steps.
desc_textfield: Returns the new text and whether Enter was pressed.
desc_flags: Flags change how a field behaves: search, password, numeric, readonly.
desc_focus: Move the focus to a field, or ask for text with the console keyboard.
desc_segmented: A row of buttons, one selected (index starts at 1 in Lua).
desc_dropdown: A compact list of choices that opens a menu.
desc_progress: A bar from 0 to 1, or -1 for work of unknown length.
desc_label: Text with an optional size, colour and font.
desc_row: A list row with hover and selection; reports clicks and double clicks.
desc_group: A rounded settings section with separators between rows.
desc_scroll: A scroll view; children use content coordinates. Touch, drag and stick scroll it.
desc_hit: Any rectangle becomes clickable and draggable. Double click resets the box.
desc_mouse: Where the pointer is. Right click (X on the controller) opens a context menu.
desc_alert: A system dialog; the callback gets the button index.
desc_prompt: A dialog that asks for text; the callback gets the text or nil.
desc_files: System open and save dialogs; the callback gets a path or nil.
readonly_text: You can select but not edit this
focus_note: The name field is on this page, above.
alert_message: This is only a demo, nothing is deleted.
saved_text: Hello from the UI Gallery demo!
